# S42 — Notifier

Send the scheduled pings via ntfy (stdlib `urllib`) and/or email (stdlib `smtplib`) (X1, X2).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:** core

**Not in this slice:** PWA push.

## Why

A short reminder at the right time ("tacos tonight, defrost turkey") makes larder useful without anyone opening it.

## Owner input

None if the notifications interview is done.

- `src/larder/notify/__init__.py` (Channel protocol)
- `src/larder/notify/ntfy.py`, `src/larder/notify/email.py`

3. Admin page to send a test ping.
